title: 长生界
summary: In a final cataclysmic battle, the ancient heroes of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors face off against the malevolent Five Heroes of Chaos. Sacrifices abound as the fate of countless realms hinges on a desperate struggle between creation and destruction. The story culminates in a bloody yet hopeful new era, where the legacy of the past shapes the future of all beings.
